llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward project todo-file helper that persistently creates and updates Markdown task files in a disclosed todos directory.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses ordinary local file and shell operations such as ls, grep, cp, and mv, scoped to todos/ and proportionate to managing file-based tasks.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown/YAML documentation and templates only, with no executable scripts, dependency installation, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to todo naming, required fields, workflow steps, and reference docs; they do not attempt session hijacking, hidden behavior, or unrelated authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It intentionally creates and updates persistent project todo files and work logs; this is disclosed and central to the purpose, with no system-level persistence or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is file-based todo and task tracking, and the artifact instructions stay aligned with creating, triaging, searching, updating, and completing Markdown todo files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Safe to install for teams that want persistent Markdown-based task tracking. Because work logs and todo files are stored in the repository or workspace, avoid recording secrets, credentials, private customer data, or sensitive internal links in those files.
